deployment_guidance.recommendation: Implement a 'warm-restart' signal that gracefully shuts down agents before updates
alternatives: Use PM2 or a similar process manager with 'reload' capabilities and automatic file-lock detection
Shadow-deploy updates to a parallel directory and swap the active symlink

batch_guidance.recommendation: Switch to a single dashboard terminal using 'blessed' or 'ink' for multi-pane monitoring
alternatives: Implement a headless daemon mode with a web-based management UI (AppForge Dashboard)
Converge all logs into a single real-time stream with source-tagging for easy filtering
